cases.title: The starter about AI agents
cases.question: How does Brad ship with AI agents?
cases.answer: Brad uses a system where agents write most of the code, with human approval at key points. Brad runs VINDecoded, a profitable vehicle-research product on Android, iOS and the web, as a one-person engineering team where AI agents write most of the code. The system around them includes docs every agent reads before it starts, one isolated checkout per agent, tests the coding agent can't rewrite, a second agent that reviews its work, a gate and a kill switch on every new feature, and one audited door to production. Releases are a separate, pinned step. Merging to master deploys nothing. Commits, pull requests, full test suites, merges and deploys each need Brad to ask for them, so an agent can't decide to ship.

cases.answer: According to Brad's essay, most new features ship turned off. Most new features reach production turned off, so merging and deploying code doesn't change what customers see.
